decisions.reason: Because this custom earmold is very close to the firm's established hearing-technology capabilities, the firm has strong absorptive capacity to refine it and is more likely to keep learning from early market use than to withdraw it quickly.
This custom in-ear earmold directly builds on the firm's existing know-how, customer base, and in-house R&D, so management would expect good scope to improve and commercialise it rather than drop it.

The vacuum thermoforming unit fits the firm's established materials-and-equipment portfolio and laboratory process knowledge, which makes it a product the firm is well placed to support and enhance instead of removing soon.
